basic_info.description: For the first time ever, this exceptional loft-style condominium, offered by its original owner, presents a unique opportunity to experience urban living at its finest. Revel in breathtaking panoramic views of Twin Peaks and the city skyline from soaring 17-foot floor-to-ceiling windows, bathing the expansive one-bedroom plus den, 1.5-bath residence in abundant natural light. The open floor plan seamlessly blends stylish exposed concrete with newer hardwood flooring and plush carpeting. Entertain with ease in the opened and combined living/dining area, prepare culinary delights in the kitchen featuring granite countertops, and unwind in the scenic bedroom or dedicated office space.   Enjoy the convenience of in-unit brand new laundry machines, walk-in closet with luxury built-in shelf systems, and one deeded parking space with extra storage. Perfectly positioned just blocks from Salesforce Park/Transbay Terminal, Oracle Park, the Ferry Building, and a wealth of city amenities, this is truly a one-of-a-kind urban sanctuary.
